title: Diagnose a weak waitlist campaign before launch
scenario:
TOPIC: Diagnose demand after a weak waitlist campaign
A B2B inventory app spent ₹40,000 over 14 days: LinkedIn produced 80 clicks and 4 signups, paid search produced 120 clicks and 18 signups, and 10 additional signups came from founder referrals. Nobody was asked to pay. The founder wants to triple both ad budgets. Segment the evidence by channel, keep organic referrals separate, note sample-size and attribution limits, identify the exact warehouse persona and current alternative, choose one next experiment with CAC and payback logic, define what would prove willingness to pay, and give a demand verdict.
improvement_suggestions: Keep each source of traffic distinct before comparing performance.
Acknowledge uncertainty created by the limited observation set.
Ask prospects for a costly commitment before increasing spend.
